homepage.title: Designed with intention. Made with individuality. Created to be personal.
homepage.description:
Jewelry beyond the expected.

A celebration of organic forms, beautiful imperfections, and individual expression. Each piece reimagines traditional silhouettes through sculptural shapes, unexpected details, and colorful natural gemstones.

Designed with intention, crafted by hand in NYC, and made exclusively with recycled precious metals and natural gemstones.
homepage.heroAlt: Malayan garnet set in a sculptural Argentium silver ring.

about:
With over a decade of experience in New York City's jewelry industry, I bring together my background as a visual artist and a management professional with a passion for jewelry design, craftsmanship, and creative expression.

As a woman, immigrant and independent designer, creating my own jewelry brand represents more than a business venture. It is an expression of my personal journey, creative independence, and desire to build something meaningful and uniquely my own.

My design philosophy is inspired by the beauty of organic forms, irregular shapes, and the unexpected. I am drawn to unconventional silhouettes, sculptural elements, and fluid lines that challenge traditional jewelry aesthetics. I believe there is beauty in imperfection and that jewelry should be expressive, distinctive, and individual.

My vision is to create jewelry that goes beyond traditional adornment. Each design is an opportunity to tell a story, celebrate individuality, and create a personal connection with the person wearing it. I also embrace personalization, offering designs that feel meaningful and reflect each individual's character and style.

Natural, colorful gemstones are an essential part of my creative language. They introduce unexpected touches of color, contrast, and personality, bringing each piece to life and highlighting its unique character.

Every piece is made to order and handcrafted in New York City, allowing for a thoughtful and intentional approach to design and production. I work exclusively with recycled silver and gold and natural gemstones, placing sustainability, quality, and craftsmanship at the center of my practice.

Ultimately, my brand is a reflection of who I am: a woman, an immigrant, an artist, and an independent designer. It celebrates individuality, embraces imperfection, and reimagines jewelry as a form of personal expression.

Designed with intention. Made with individuality. Created to be personal.

jewelry.title: Solaris Flow Pendant
jewelry.description:
Inspired by the radiance of the sun and the beauty of fluid movement, the Solaris Flow Pendant features an organic sunburst design crafted in Argentium silver or 14kt yellow gold.

At its center sits a 5 mm natural round gemstone, available in Iolite, Blue Topaz, or Amethyst.

Available with a 16" or 18" chain, this pendant brings a touch of effortless elegance to everyday wear.

jewelry.title: Past, Present & Future Necklace
jewelry.description:
A celebration of life's journey, the Past, Present & Future Pendant features three gemstones in a delicate, fluid design, symbolizing the moments that shape us and the memories we carry forward.

Each 4 mm round  natural gemstone is set in a sleek, minimalist setting, available in three variations: Tricolor Spinel, Black Spinel, or Opal.

Crafted in Argentium silver or 14kt gold, with your choice of a 16" or 18" chain.

A timeless piece that brings together meaningful symbolism and effortless elegance.

jewelry.title: Sculptural Silver Necklace
jewelry.description:
Inspired by the beauty of fluid movement, the Sculptural Necklace features an organic, free-flowing silhouette with irregular curves that capture the elegance of natural forms.

Available in Argentium silver or 14kt gold, its smooth, polished surface and unique shape create a statement piece that feels both modern and timeless.

Offered with your choice of a 15", 16", or 18" chain, this necklace is a celebration of individuality and effortless elegance, designed to flow naturally with you.

jewelry.title: Liquida Ring
jewelry.description:
Inspired by the beauty of molten metal and fluid movement, the Liquida Ring features an organic, free-flowing design with irregular curves that embrace the natural beauty of each gemstone.

A one-of-a-kind, made-to-order statement ring, featuring a natural 8 × 6 mm gemstone, available in London Blue Topaz, Amethyst, Blue Sapphire, Garnet, or Peridot.

Crafted in your choice of Argentium silver or 14kt yellow gold, its smooth, polished finish and sculptural details create a bold yet timeless piece.

A celebration of individuality, fluidity, and effortless elegance, each ring is uniquely made to capture the beauty of liquid forms frozen in time.
